name: Manufacturing & Industrial
org_structure_note: Plant-centric with centralized corporate functions. Strong operations hierarchy. Shift-based work adds complexity.
funding_stages: Slower growth, higher barriers to entry.

regional_notes.na: Union presence varies by state (strong in auto). Rust Belt vs Sun Belt. OSHA strict.
regional_notes.emea: Germany Industrie 4.0 leader. IG Metall strong union. EU environmental regulations strictest globally.
regional_notes.apac: China: fastest manufacturing ecosystem. Japan: TPS/lean origin. Korea: advanced semiconductors. Vietnam: growing.
regional_notes.latam: Mexico automotive/aerospace. Brazil industrial base. Nearshoring from US accelerating. Infrastructure challenges.
